proposals.reason: prEN 18228 (AI risk management for AI Act Article 9) completed final approval vote, ratification imminent.

card.t: prEN 18228 — AI Risk Management Final Vote Completed
card.x: Final approval vote completed for AI risk management standard transposing AI Act Article 9 requirements. Ratification and publication now scheduled for 30 September 2026. Once cited in OJEU, compliance confers presumption of conformity.

proposals.reason: prEN 18229-3 (AI human oversight) public enquiry closes in 13 days, final vote scheduled July 2027.

card.t: prEN 18229-3 — AI Human Oversight Public Enquiry Closes
card.x: Public enquiry on human oversight of AI systems (part 3 of 5-part AI trustworthiness framework) closes. Stakeholder comments must be submitted before this deadline. Final vote scheduled 1 July 2027.

proposals.reason: UK government formally adopted all 44 NHS AI commission recommendations, MHRA to publish change management guidance by December 2026.

card.t: UK MHRA — 44 AI Healthcare Recommendations Adopted
card.x: Government formally adopted all 44 NHS AI commission recommendations. MHRA to publish draft guidance on AI device change management before end 2026, public consultation on qualification/classification criteria opens early 2027. Continuous lifecycle surveillance replaces one-time assessment model.

proposals.reason: FDA CDRH FY 2027 agenda prioritizes final guidance on AI lifecycle governance and predetermined change control plans.

card.t: FDA CDRH FY 2027 — AI & PCCP Guidance Priority
card.x: CDRH work program prioritizes final guidance on AI device lifecycle governance and predetermined change control plans (PCCP), allowing pre-approved ML/AI algorithm modifications without new submissions for each change.

proposals.reason: CNIL granted 10-year authorization for LINK, Clinityx's European health data warehouse spanning 7 countries.

card.t: CNIL — LINK European Health Data Warehouse Authorized
card.x: CNIL deliberation 2026-070 grants 10-year authorization to LINK (Clinityx/Cegedim), European health data warehouse spanning 7 countries. In France, interconnects primary care data with SNDS within EHDS framework.

proposals.reason: Three harmonised European standards on digital identity management published by CEN/CENELEC JTC 13.

card.t: EN ISO/IEC 24760 — Digital Identity Standards Published
card.x: CEN/CENELEC JTC 13 published three-part digital identity management standard series: Part 1 (terminology/concepts), Part 2 (architecture/requirements), Part 3 (implementation guidance). Directly relevant for patient/professional authentication systems and GDPR compliance.

proposals.reason: Four harmonised medical device and health IT standards published by CEN between 2 and 30 September 2026.

card.x: CEN published: EN ISO 10993-3:2026 (biocompatibility), EN ISO 13606-4:2026 (EHR security), EN ISO 20737:2026 (clinical decision support interoperability), EN ISO 11607-3:2026 (device packaging/sterilization).

proposals.reason: MHRA AI Airlock Phase 3 accepts applications until 31 October for current review wave.

card.t: UK MHRA AI Airlock Phase 3 — Application Deadline
card.x: Phase 3 application deadline for current review wave. Program now operates on continuous calendar (year-round applications). Phase 3 focuses on post-market surveillance and full lifecycle oversight of AI medical devices.
